_jmto_: On Day 9, Emil "Spark" Jmto arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Emil "Spark" Jmto wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Emil "Spark" Jmto fired at the enemy dawn watch from Q-F9. Dorian Noamorax was gravely wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Emil "Spark" Jmto read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Emil "Spark" Jmto measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.

A bullet hit Emil "Spark" Jmto's belt buckle at Q-F9 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Quentin "Crow" Bannerlordsa of the Hegemony (@bannerlordsarp).

A bullet went through Emil "Spark" Jmto's upper arm at Q-F9 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Casimir Nshill of the Hegemony (@nshill429).
Emil "Spark" Jmto lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant.
Emil "Spark" Jmto healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving.
The shelling stopped while Emil "Spark" Jmto was counting the seconds between hits. He kept counting anyway, and waited a long time before moving.
Emil has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Bastian "Parson" Wamble, grazed.
fedakidd: Edmund Fedakidd came up on Day 9 carrying news from Tannenfeld. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired. Orders came through: Edmund Fedakidd is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only his brother's pocket watch.

From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Edmund Fedakidd wrote to a grandmother who prays for both armies that night and said only: 'We will take it back.' A letter from home found Edmund Fedakidd before the night shift. Edmund Fedakidd folded it small and kept it close.

Edmund Fedakidd wrote the range on the back of a ration card: 380 yards. Then Edmund Fedakidd used it. Quentin Tangibliciou was gravely wounded. A letter from home found Edmund Fedakidd before the night shift. Edmund Fedakidd folded it small and kept it close. After the loss of Grey Mill, Edmund Fedakidd helped stack spare sandbags at T-F4. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
An empty jam tin became Edmund Fedakidd's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips.

Edmund Fedakidd found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases. A letter from home found Edmund Fedakidd before the night shift. Edmund Fedakidd folded it small and kept it close.

Edmund Fedakidd crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at Q-F11 holds again. Machine-gun fire swept T-F4. Edmund Fedakidd took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Leopold "Parson" Carlosm of the Hegemony (@carlosm.jr). A letter from home found Edmund Fedakidd before the night shift. Edmund Fedakidd folded it small and kept it close.

The bearers moved Edmund Fedakidd's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule. A letter from home found Edmund Fedakidd before the night shift. Edmund Fedakidd folded it small and kept it close.
Edmund Fedakidd did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.
The House of Fedakidd sent Severin "Lucky" Fedakidd after Edmund Fedakidd. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.

The bread was divided with a ruler. Severin "Lucky" Fedakidd received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler. A letter from home found Severin "Lucky" Fedakidd before the night shift. Severin "Lucky" Fedakidd folded it small and kept it close.

The order named Severin as Lance Corporal. He read it twice, then asked who would take over his watch. Severin got a postcard of the old church at home. The tower was drawn in with ink in case Severin had forgotten it.
ghosteye95: Dietrich Ghosteye came up the line with a pressed cornflower and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Dietrich Ghosteye kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Someone returned an empty pot polished with bread. Dietrich Ghosteye accepted it as a review. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Dietrich Ghosteye answered to number 682. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Dietrich Ghosteye watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Dietrich Ghosteye counted the ladles in the pot against the men in the queue. The last serving took some careful scraping.
Dietrich Ghosteye and Felix Landon tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
Dietrich Ghosteye bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage.
The cook borrowed Dietrich Ghosteye's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.
Dietrich Ghosteye practised asking for bread in the local language. The dugout supplied an audience and several confidently incorrect pronunciations.
Dietrich Ghosteye (Concord) and Albin Ollie (Hegemony) were sent out to cut the other side's wire at the Sunken Road on the same night. They met in the middle and agreed to go home.
A local carter understood Dietrich's request for bread, then explained that the same sentence sounded very much like a request for a beard.
hunted_j16: On Day 3 Henrik Hunted took a post at R-F4 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He collects shell fuses, and the men liked him for it.
Cyril "Mole" Skies of the Hegemony spotted Henrik Hunted of the Concord repairing a parapet at the Drowned Farm. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot.
Officers came to inspect R-F4. Henrik Hunted polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is.

Henrik Hunted had Jakub "Hollow" Hill of the Hegemony in the sights at the Hanging Bridge for a long second. Jakub "Hollow" Hill was lighting a pipe. Henrik Hunted let the match burn all the way down. Hill 304 is lost. Henrik Hunted heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Henrik Hunted tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog.
Henrik Hunted and Ivo Joha divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
A rat stole Henrik Hunted's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Henrik Hunted across the shin at R-F4. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Jonas Solyommadar of the Hegemony (@solyommadar11).

Henrik Hunted walked back up the communication trench to R-F4, slower than before, but on his own feet. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Henrik Hunted read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Henrik Hunted borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Henrik Hunted answered to number 226. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In R-F4, Henrik Hunted listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
A bullet grazed Henrik Hunted's ribs at R-F4. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Nils "Bones" Martinvajda of the Hegemony (@martinvajda.21).
Henrik Hunted's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
The cook borrowed Henrik Hunted's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.
A note came over the wire at the Hanging Bridge, wrapped around a stone: 'Stop singing, Concord. Signed, Norbert "Doc" Chiaroveto.' Henrik Hunted sang louder.
Henrik Hunted was on watch at R-F4 when the night raid hit. The men found Henrik Hunted at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Emil Painter of the Hegemony (@neophyte_painter).
The House of Hunted sent another. Severin Hunted, father of Henrik Hunted, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
Severin Hunted was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked.
Frost made each footprint distinct. Severin followed a trail to the missing ration sack and found the quartermaster sitting on it.
james_argall_05: "You're late," said the corporal when Yann Argall arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Yann Argall had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Roland Hyniiiis crossed it, Yann Argall fired. Roland Hyniiiis was badly wounded. After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Yann Argall helped stack spare sandbags at T-S6. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Yann Argall was carrying water up to T-S6 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Yann Argall did not. Shot by Jonas "Whistle" Crawford of the Hegemony (@logan.crawford283). A single shot at T-S6. Yann Argall sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Jonas "Whistle" Crawford of the Hegemony (@logan.crawford283).

Jonas "Hollow" Argall asked about Yann Argall on arriving at T-S6. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Jonas "Hollow" Argall watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Jonas "Hollow" Argall gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.
In the fog a figure walked along the parapet of T-S6. When Jonas "Hollow" Argall challenged it, there was nobody there.
Jonas "Hollow" Argall tried to remember the price of a loaf in Northwick. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.
Jonas "Hollow" Argall read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing.
Jonas "Hollow" Argall saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at T-S6 and fired once. Walter "Ghost" Design was badly wounded.
The men have learned that Jonas "Hollow" Argall whistles the same four notes over and over. Tonight it made them laugh, which was worth a great deal.
Jonas had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Walter "Bones" Boccadifuoco, badly wounded.
joodiizzzlee: The old hands of N-F1 have been here since Day 1. Gustav Joodiizzzlee has been here since Day 13. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
Arno "Whistle" Bhutia fixed the strap on Gustav Joodiizzzlee's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
Gustav Joodiizzzlee owes Tobias "Crow" Cowboii so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full.
Teodor "Smokes" Henrywestgam taught Gustav Joodiizzzlee to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.
Gustav Joodiizzzlee fired a single round through a crack in the enemy's steel plate, a gap no wider than a finger. Roland Michaelorlov was grazed.
Teodor "Brick" Bhutia and Gustav Joodiizzzlee swapped hats for a day to see if anyone would notice. Nobody did, and both were a little insulted.
miguell.jacob: The new runner is Otto "Ash" Jacob, once a coal miner from Millbank. The corporal asked if a coal miner was any use in a trench. Otto "Ash" Jacob said he would find out.
Volunteer number 41. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Otto "Ash" Jacob's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'
Otto "Ash" Jacob began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.
News of the loss of Verdel Ridge reached R-F14 with the rations. Otto "Ash" Jacob ate while listening to the revised orders.
The reply to Otto "Ash" Jacob's chess move arrived with a long complaint about the weather at home and a note that his opponent had taken a pawn.
Otto "Ash" Jacob and Wendel "Mole" Freddie made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A single shot from across the wire hit Otto "Ash" Jacob in the thigh at R-F14. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Hill 304. Otto "Ash" Jacob folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Outside the aid post, Otto "Ash" Jacob lies on a stretcher among the others. The orderlies step over him and say soon. Otto "Ash" Jacob's wound turned bad. The bandage was not enough and he was carried back to wait for a bed. Otto "Ash" Jacob finally has a bed in the hospital dugout. A real blanket, a lamp, and a surgeon who has not slept.
Otto "Ash" Jacob opened his eyes today and asked for water. At R-F14 they cheered when the news came up the line.
The medics called Otto "Ash" Jacob 'the corridor man', because he lay there so long. Today the corridor is empty. Otto "Ash" Jacob is back on the line.

A bullet hit Otto "Ash" Jacob in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at R-F14. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Edmund "Whistle" Es of the Concord (@es31230). Otto "Ash" Jacob was killed outright at R-F14, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Edmund "Whistle" Es of the Concord (@es31230).

A letter came with Rafael Jacob: "I am Otto "Ash" Jacob's father. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes. The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Rafael Jacob was number 41. He still remembers how stiff the colonel's glove felt.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Rafael Jacob was hit hard in the fight at R-F14 before anyone could fire. The raider was Karel Pavla of the Concord. Raider: Karel Pavla of the Concord (@pavla.9_). Victory at Blackwater Canal. Rafael Jacob let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

The medic looked at Rafael Jacob's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to R-F14. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Rafael Jacob watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Rafael Jacob (Hegemony) watched Hugo Gdaydane (Concord) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at Saint-Ash crossroads, and held fire until both were gone.
Rafael Jacob took stock of his pockets: string, crumbs, a pencil and no sign of the button he was looking for.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Rafael Jacob put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.
Rafael Jacob sang under his breath on sentry. Across the wire, very quietly, somebody sang the next line.

Rafael Jacob went over with the night raiders, found the enemy trench empty at that spot, and came back with a bag of their biscuits. A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at R-F14. Rafael Jacob was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Ulrich Alessiosanto of the Concord (@alessiosantori).
Jonas Jacob came to the front because his uncle Rafael Jacob never came home. He carries a tin whistle.

A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Jonas Jacob aimed just below it. Gideon Actioncam was grazed. A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Jonas Jacob aimed a step ahead and fired: Karel Bachini, grazed.
Jonas found a torn book about the night sky in a ruined library. It has no cover, but it has pictures of stars.
niarchos_n: Benedikt "Button" Niarchos joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Benedikt "Button" Niarchos listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Benedikt "Button" Niarchos waited for that to change. When it did, Albin Zgz was badly wounded. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Benedikt "Button" Niarchos answered to number 738. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Benedikt "Button" Niarchos could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Benedikt "Button" Niarchos fired, and Dietrich Caydan was badly wounded.
Benedikt "Button" Niarchos fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Gideon "Shadow" Owenhart, now grazed.
Officers came to inspect S-C7. Benedikt "Button" Niarchos polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is.
Benedikt "Button" Niarchos reached up to fix a sandbag at S-C7 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Tobias "Crow" Cowboii of the Concord (@the_cowboii).
Back on the fire step at S-C7. Benedikt "Button" Niarchos says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.

Benedikt "Button" Niarchos fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Isidor Glc was grazed, and that rifle did not fire again tonight. A splinter opened Benedikt "Button" Niarchos's cheek at S-C7. A medic stitched it on the spot and he was back on the fire step before the tea went cold.

Benedikt took a bullet in the side at S-C7. His friends laid him on a door and walked very carefully. Shot by Jonas Little of the Concord (@evan.little.14). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Benedikt fell at S-C7 and never moved again.
Matthias Niarchos came to the front because his older brother Benedikt "Button" Niarchos never came home. He carries a dented harmonica.
randall_norton_200: Hugo Norton arrived at V-F2 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.
A mouse ran across Hugo's boot and into a biscuit tin. He let it stay. It was the only visitor all day.
seanspence07: On Day 16 Albin Seanspence took a post at N-F22 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He hates silence more than shelling, and the men liked him for it.

Machine-gun fire swept N-F22. Albin Seanspence took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Zeno Cas of the Concord (@jordan_cas88). Albin Seanspence looked over the parapet at N-F22 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Zeno Cas of the Concord (@jordan_cas88).
Otto "Parson" Seanspence arrived carrying the family name of Albin Seanspence. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Otto read a theatre review while peeling supper.
someonenamedmiguel: Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed walked into R-F19 on Day 3 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed (Concord) shouted a challenge across to Otto Elitecelebs (Hegemony) at Calvary Farm. The answer was lost under the guns. Nobody repeated the challenge.

Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed fixed the strap on Gideon "Ghost" Marks's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut. A letter from home found Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed before the night shift. Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet clipped Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed's helmet at R-F19 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. A letter from home found Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed before the night shift. Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed folded it small and kept it close. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

A bullet found Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed at R-F19, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Marek Dream of the Hegemony (@initial_dream8.6). A letter from home found Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed before the night shift. Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed folded it small and kept it close.
Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.
Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed had heard about Konrad "Mud" Someonenamed's courage. At R-F19, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed felt a hard tug at his hip at R-F19. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Cyril Zgeorges of the Hegemony (@zgeorges11). A letter from home found Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed before the night shift. Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed folded it small and kept it close.

Machine-gun fire swept R-F19. Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Severin Lagbagdotzip of the Hegemony (@lagbagdotzip).

Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed reached the hospital dugout after a long wait. The surgeon took one look at the wound and went to wash up. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools. A letter from home found Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed before the night shift. Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed folded it small and kept it close.

Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line. Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 227. The men who came later will ask about it. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed wrote to a mother who sets a place for him at every meal that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed had just lit a cigarette at R-F19 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Marek Dream of the Hegemony (@initial_dream8.6). A letter from home found Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed before the night shift. Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed folded it small and kept it close.

Back on the fire step at R-F19. Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign. A letter from home found Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed before the night shift. Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed folded it small and kept it close. Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed transferred to the stretcher bearers. The men in R-F19 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.
Wind kept turning the pages of Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed's letter. He held them down with a biscuit and finished with crumbs in the ink.

Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed was found at the bottom of the trench at R-F19, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Edmund "Saint" Nazareth of the Hegemony (@nazareth_2bc). Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed was killed outright at R-F19, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Edmund "Saint" Nazareth of the Hegemony (@nazareth_2bc).
Felix Someonenamed joined R-F19 under the shadow of Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

At R-F19 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Felix Someonenamed turned around and took a shovel blow. Bastian Enjoyer of the Hegemony was already gone. Raider: Bastian Enjoyer of the Hegemony (@autism_enjoyer_08). There was a letter for Felix Someonenamed and a little tobacco folded inside. The tobacco went round the squad. The letter did not.
A round came through the loophole Felix Someonenamed was watching at R-F19 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Severin Vazintian of the Hegemony (@vazintian).

Felix lay a night and a day on a stretcher in the open trench. Then he stood up, shook out the blanket and went back to R-F19. The letter for Felix was mostly about the weather at home. Felix read that part twice too.
thomas_potvin.i: Isidor "Parson" Potvin took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

Isidor "Parson" Potvin put an empty tin under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal. Isidor "Parson" Potvin walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Marek Zenga of the Concord and Isidor "Parson" Potvin of the Hegemony have carved their names into the same post in no man's land at Blackwater Canal. It is getting crowded.
Part of the parapet collapsed near Isidor "Parson" Potvin. Repairs started as soon as the dust settled, with one man on watch while the rest worked.
The trench wall shook against Isidor "Parson" Potvin's shoulder during the bombardment. He pressed both feet into the boards and waited for the next hit.
Thunder all night. Isidor "Parson" Potvin flinched at every crack. The old hands said that is how you spot the new ones. By morning, they were flinching too.
Isidor "Parson" Potvin borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.

Isidor "Parson" Potvin was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at T-F22. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Wendel "Bones" Dyl of the Concord (@__dyl_g).

Isidor was hit through the stomach at T-F22. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Arno "Rabbit" Snake of the Concord (@__snake__cx). A rifle shot from the far side killed Isidor at T-F22. The men on either side did not know until he slid down the wall.
Oskar Potvin put a frozen apple beside the bunk. Someone who had known Isidor "Parson" Potvin helped clear the shelf without saying why.
tom_ua_: In Belmonte, Anselm Tom was a railway porter. In S-F9, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a railway porter again.
Volunteer number 94. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Anselm Tom's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'
The transfer made Anselm Tom a machine gunner. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.
Edmund Somosmagios and Anselm Tom compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
Anselm Tom thought about a younger sister who sends drawings on sentry tonight, and the cold felt a little further away.

Anselm Tom cut Matthias Mihai's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short. Verdel Ridge is lost. Anselm Tom heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Splinters from a shell rained down on S-F9. Anselm Tom took one in the shoulder and had it dug out right there on the fire step.
The wound Anselm Tom shrugged off has gone the wrong colour. He is not shrugging any more.

Anselm Tom drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer. The Hegemony flag went up over Hill 304. Anselm Tom did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Anselm Tom did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.

Ulrich Tom took the same post at S-F9 where Anselm Tom stood. He found his older brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them. The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Ulrich Tom was number 94. He still remembers how stiff the colonel's glove felt.

A sniper's bullet hit Ulrich Tom at S-F9. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Norbert Slc of the Concord (@maks.slc). An orderly waved the bearers in: one bed, cleared and scrubbed. Ulrich Tom was lifted onto it in the hospital dugout. The worst has passed for Ulrich Tom. The surgeon says he will live, though not quickly.
Ulrich Tom healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving.
Ulrich Tom checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Ulrich Tom shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

A loose thread in Ulrich Tom's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain. Grey Mill has been won. Ulrich Tom listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
The section held a competition for the worst joke. Ulrich Tom won before reaching the end of his entry.
Ulrich Tom hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back.
Ulrich Tom sang the first verse tonight, out loud. The other side sang the second. Nobody fired for an hour.
A bullet went through Ulrich Tom's sleeve at S-F9 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Ivo Gabhita of the Concord (@gabhita09).

Ulrich Tom was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at S-F9. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Valentin Thorholting of the Concord (@thorholting). Ulrich Tom looked over the parapet at S-F9 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Valentin Thorholting of the Concord (@thorholting).
The House of Tom sent another. Isidor Tom, uncle of Ulrich Tom, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
The cook's stew tasted of iron and smoke. Isidor Tom ate two helpings anyway.
A cheerful man from the next unit came by to borrow a match. Isidor gave him the whole box and regretted nothing.
xavierzane.c: Severin Xavierzane unpacked a bullet that missed him at Q-F10. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.

The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In Q-F10, Severin Xavierzane listened to three explanations and trusted none of them. A letter from home found Severin Xavierzane before the night shift. Severin Xavierzane folded it small and kept it close.

Severin Xavierzane was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at Q-F10. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Bastian "Parson" Wamble of the Hegemony (@josh.wamble). Severin Xavierzane fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Jonas "Lucky" Anish, badly wounded. Nobody nearby said anything. Severin Xavierzane was killed at Q-F10 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Bastian "Parson" Wamble of the Hegemony (@josh.wamble).

Another member of the House of Xavierzane reached the line: Emil "Doc" Xavierzane. He asked where Severin Xavierzane had slept, then chose a different corner. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Emil "Doc" Xavierzane stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Emil "Doc" Xavierzane had kept the gun aimed at the enemy supply path for days. Tonight the supply party came, and Ulrich Anish was gravely wounded.

Emil "Doc" Xavierzane was hit through the chest at Q-F10. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Bastian "Parson" Wamble of the Hegemony (@josh.wamble). A single shot at Q-F10. Emil "Doc" Xavierzane sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Bastian "Parson" Wamble of the Hegemony (@josh.wamble).

Bastian Xavierzane joined Q-F10 under the shadow of Emil "Doc" Xavierzane's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one. Orders came through: Bastian Xavierzane is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a bullet that missed him.

A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Bastian Xavierzane closed his eyes while someone else distributed them. A letter from home found Bastian Xavierzane before the night shift. Bastian Xavierzane folded it small and kept it close.
A man asked Bastian Xavierzane to describe Halden without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.
The shelling stopped while Bastian Xavierzane was counting the seconds between hits. He kept counting anyway, and waited a long time before moving.
A bullet hit the sandbag beside Bastian Xavierzane. He ducked, and noticed his hands were shaking. He kept working anyway.
Bastian pulled Gustav "Tin" Ratpick out of a flooded shell hole at the Sunken Road. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
zgeorges11: Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges arrived on Day 3 as a replacement. The men in R-F18 had been fighting for 2 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world. Verdel Ridge is lost. Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges fired at a movement across the wire at R-F18. The man went down: Gideon "Whistle" Vylet, grazed.

Benedikt Jakubwilkuu (Concord) and Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges (Hegemony) ended up in the same shell hole at the Chalk Pits. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone. A letter from home found Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges before the night shift. Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges folded it small and kept it close.

A trench mortar bomb landed in the next section of trench. The blast caught Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges at R-F18 and the bearers came at a run. A letter from home found Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges before the night shift. Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges folded it small and kept it close. Word came down the line: Hill 304 is ours. Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges spent the night on a stretcher in the trench behind the aid post. Every bed was taken. A letter from home found Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges before the night shift. Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges folded it small and kept it close.
Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges died waiting. The men at R-F18 have not stopped talking about it.
The papers say Cyril Zgeorges. The sergeant says he has his father's eyes. Teodor "Crow" Zgeorges's eyes. Nobody in R-F18 argues.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Cyril Zgeorges fired, and Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed was grazed.
Cyril Zgeorges and Wendel "Rabbit" Macdonald split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.

A bullet found Cyril Zgeorges at R-F18, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Ivo "Bones" David of the Concord (@david2449_). Cyril Zgeorges was killed at R-F18 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Ivo "Bones" David of the Concord (@david2449_).
A letter came with Ulrich "Ash" Zgeorges: "I am Cyril Zgeorges's uncle. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.

Ulrich "Ash" Zgeorges tried to describe the smell of Halden and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Ulrich "Ash" Zgeorges answered to number 170. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Ulrich "Ash" Zgeorges did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Ulrich "Ash" Zgeorges brought back a wounded man and a lost machine gun from the Chalk Pits in one trip. He is Lance Corporal now.

Ulrich "Ash" Zgeorges was found at the bottom of the trench at R-F18, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Ulrich Deanc of the Concord (@deanc_67). The bearers reached Ulrich "Ash" Zgeorges at R-F18 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Ulrich Deanc of the Concord (@deanc_67).
Ivo Zgeorges joined R-F18 under the shadow of Ulrich "Ash" Zgeorges's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

Ivo Zgeorges had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any. A letter from home found Ivo Zgeorges before the night shift. Ivo Zgeorges folded it small and kept it close.
The patrol came back one man at a time. Ivo Zgeorges held the gap open and counted until the corporal said that was everyone.

At R-F18 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Ivo Zgeorges turned around and took a shovel blow. Anselm Rakan of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Anselm Rakan of the Concord (@rakan_1027).

Ivo Zgeorges no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. The letter for Ivo Zgeorges had been in the rain somewhere along the way. Ivo Zgeorges dried it by the stove, page by page.
Ivo saw Norbert Weirddough freeze up on the fire step at the Ossuary Wood. Ivo said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.
